title: Low-speed electric bicycles; operator age.
bodyText: No person under the age of fifteen shall operate a low-speed electric bicycle as defined under title 15 United States Code section 2085.
bodyHtml: [§291C-143.5]  Low-speed electric bicycles; operator age.  No person under the age of fifteen shall operate a low-speed electric bicycle as defined under title 15 United States Code section 2085. [L 2019, c 208, §1]
